programme.title: Insecure
programme.desc: Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a twenty-something African American woman, lives in Los Angeles.Although she experiences many humiliations, she tries to fight against her chronic lack of self-confidence and her own weaknesses.The lack of money and work problems don't help her at all.Her best friend is Molly (Yvonne Orji), a self-centered lawyer.The series tells the story of the lives of contemporary black women living in the United States.Its originator and producer is the main actress, Issa Rae (First).The artist gained popularity thanks to the website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel - so far she has collected over 200,000 likes.followers and 20 million plays.Yvonne Orji (Love That Girl!), Jay Ellis (The Rules of the Game) and Lisa Joyce (It's Never Too Late) will also appear on screen.Critics compare the series to the cult HBO production titled "Girls".

programme.title: The Last of Us
programme.desc: Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title.

programme.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programme.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programme.title: The Pitt
programme.desc: Santos investigates how Langdon prescribes drugs to his regular patient Louie Cloverfield.Rita wakes up in the car.He returns to duty immediately.A patient with a severed finger flirts with Collins.The team fails to save Amber, a 6-year-old drowning victim.Javadi diagnoses a spider bite.The symptoms were mistaken for Crohn's disease.Nick's parents finally agree to the transplant.McKay suspects Piper may be a victim of human trafficking.He and Dana try to help her.Mel has difficulty with Bella.Robby informs Willie of Adamson's death.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mysterious plague turns most people into bloodthirsty zombies.Only a few manage to avoid infection.This lucky group includes a clumsy and clumsy Columbus student.The boy is afraid of almost everything.The prospect of living in a world overrun by beasts terrifies him.Meanwhile, his friend, the brave Tallahassee, is excited about the whole situation.He is a tough guy who intends to single-handedly kill every monster that stands in his way.The men must fight the monsters together.They can count on the help of the sisters - Wichita and Little Rock.The girls try to alleviate the tense atmosphere between the men.For them, enduring each other's company is as difficult as getting rid of zombies.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Ten years have passed since Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson), Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg), Wichita (Emma Stone) and Little Rock (Abigail Breslin) decided to face a world full of the living dead together.It seemed that they knew everything about zombies and knew how to deal with them.Over time, however, bloodthirsty creatures managed to evolve and spread throughout the country.Four heroes must face a new threat.The problems are mounting, and there are typical family conflicts between them.On their way, they also meet other survivors.Sequel to "Zombieland" from 2009.This is another collaboration between Jesse Eisenberg and Woody Harrelson - they met, among others,on the set of two parts of "Illusion".A mixture of chocolate and coffee was used to create realistic-looking blood - the main actors agreed that it tasted like chemicals and they would not like to play zombie characters who had this fake blood in their mouths and on their teeth.

programme.title: Undercurrent: The Disappearance of Kim Wall
programme.desc: The story of the murder of Swedish reporter Kim Wall, which took place in August 2017.As the investigation revealed, famous inventor Peter Madsen lured a woman into an underwater boat that he built himself.During a cruise along the coast of Copenhagen, Wall was to interview the designer.When she did not return, a search began which revealed the shocking truth.The case of the journalist's death also draws attention to the issue of women's safety in the modern world.Wall received specialized training to prepare her for various work situations.Despite this, she died in a theoretically safe place.

programme.title: The List
programme.desc: Matt is cheating on his fiancée Abby with a celebrity from the "exceptions to monogamy" list.The hurt woman decides to pay him back in kind.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programme.title: L'amica geniale
programme.desc: Elena Greco is an elderly woman who tries to solve the mystery of the disappearance of her friend - Raffaella Ceruullo, who was called Lila.The women met in their early youth - in 1950, when they attended primary school.The old woman recalls her early years.The action of the series takes place in dangerous and charming Naples and spans 60 years.The story of their relationship is unconventional, because although Lila was Elena's best friend and confidant, she was also her enemy.The series is an adaptation of the novel by Elena Ferrante Elena returns to Naples.However, he keeps his experiences on the island a secret because he is ashamed to talk about them even to Lili.She, in turn, confides in her friend everything that happened to her this summer.Although her parents support her relationship with Marcello Solara, Lila chooses Stefano Carraccio and even gets engaged to him.A young man spoils his beloved.He gives her gifts and speaks highly of her shoe designs.He also wants to become a family partner in business matters and distribute the shoe models prepared by Lila.Elena realizes that her friend is gaining more and more sympathy from the neighborhood boys, and because she doesn't want to stand out from her too much, she also finds a new partner.The choice falls on Antonio, a car mechanic whom she cannot even love.Elena wants to find out if Lila really has feelings for Stefan.The friend confirms, but at the same time puts Elena first.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Antarctica.Mambo was born in a land famous for penguins with vocal talent.Singing gives them a sense of community and cements relationships.Unfortunately, Mambo does not have this ability.His mother Norma Jean sees nothing wrong with it, but Memphis' father fears for the future of his son who, due to his inability, may never find his soul mate.The penguin has another valuable gift - he can tap dance perfectly.However, this is not enough for his friend Gloria, the best singer in the area and the leader of the Penguin Empire, who banishes Mamba.He thinks that he doesn't fit in with the rest of the herd.While traveling alone, the exile encounters alien penguins.They are delighted with his tap dancing ability and invite him to their land.There, the penguin discovers a very important truth in life, which says that being yourself is the most important thing.An excellent family film, awarded with an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programme.desc: The Fellowship of the Ring has been broken.Frodo and Sam continue their journey to Mordor - the only place where the Ring can be destroyed.They manage to capture Gollum, one of the previous owners of the magical gem.Frodo decides to trust him.She makes him her guide.Meanwhile, Gandalf the Gray fights the Balrog, the Demon of Power.After the duel, the wizard is reborn as Gandalf the White.He joins Aragorn, Legolas the elf and Gimli the dwarf as they journey to Rohan.They must warn the local ruler Théoden about the war.It turns out that he can no longer rule.His faith and strength were robbed by a curse cast by Saruman.Merry and Pippin escape from orc captivity to Fangorn - an ancient forest.Treebeard, the shepherd of trees, takes care of them there.Middle-earth is threatened by great danger - Sauron, ruler of Mordor, and the wizard Saruman, lord of Isengard, unite their forces.Troops of wild Uruk-hai are growing in strength.The day of the Battle of Helm's Deep is approaching.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time marijuana dealer David Clark tries to help teenagers living in his neighborhood.He is attacked by three homeless punks and robbed of his goods and cash.As a result, he becomes indebted to his supplier, Brad Gurdlinger.To repay the debt, he must import the latest batch of stimulants from Mexico.To conceal himself, he arranges helpers to pretend to be his immediate family going on holiday with him.So David's neighbors go on the road with him: cynical stripper Rose O'Reilly, the drug dealer's would-be client, the dim-witted Kenny Rossmore, and the smart, street-savvy teenager Casey Mathis.A laugh-out-loud action movie full of well-acted episodes and indecent gags.This is another joint project of Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston, after the comedies "Get Your Ex" and "Horrible Bosses".

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: The year is 1932. Twin brothers Smoke and Stack (double role of Michael B. Jordan), who have a difficult past, return from Chicago to their hometown in Mississippi.They try to escape from problems and a life of crime.They establish a music club for black people and hope for a new beginning.Their enemy, however, are dark, sinister forces that they must face.At stake is not only the lives of the brothers and their loved ones, but also their culture, history and memory.A dark cinema combining elements of action, horror and a musical drawing on the blues tradition.It is a story about an attempt at redemption and the fight against an invisible evil that symbolizes the weight of the past and past sins.

programme.title: I Am Not A Monster: The Lois Riess Murders
programme.desc: HBO 3 is the home of acclaimed television series and cult favorites, focusing on immersive storytelling and marathon-worthy drama from the HBO library.

programme.title: Everest
programme.desc: The year 1996. Rob Hall (Jason Clarke) organizes a commercial expedition to the highest mountain in the world.His brigade includes, among others:Texan Beck Weathers (Josh Brolin) and reporter Jon Krakauer (Michael Kelly).The mountaineers reach the base camp.Over the course of several weeks, they get used to extreme weather conditions and pressure that disregulates the body.Apart from them, other teams are heading to the summit.Hall makes a strategic decision to join Scott Fischer (Jake Gyllenhaal), the head of the Mountain Madness expedition.At the beginning of May, climbers leave the base camp.They struggle with snow storms, bitter cold and lack of oxygen.Extreme conditions put them at the edge of their mental and physical endurance.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: Secrets of the Furious Five
programme.desc: After defeating Tai Lung, Po the panda gains the title of Dragon Warrior.Master Shifu assigns the bear another task - to teach kung fu.Enthusiastic bunnies become new adepts of the eastern martial art.In addition to improving his technique, Po must instill in the children the philosophy of kung-fu and character traits such as courage, self-confidence and patience.To achieve the goal, he tells them stories from the past of great warriors - the Crane, the Viper, the Tigress, the Monkey and the Mantis... In the Polish language version, they lent their voices to characters including:Marcin Hycnar (Po) and Jan Peszek (Shifu).

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.Devastated, Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Julia
programme.desc: The year is 1962. A cookbook written by Julia Child (Sarah Lancashire) has recently hit the bookstore.Soon, an energetic woman, a graduate of the prestigious Le Cordon Bleu school, begins to appear in American homes thanks to the television program "The French Chef".The well-liked cook, full of joy in life, also feels fulfilled in her private life.She is supported in all her activities by her loving husband Paul (David Hyde Pierce).Together, the couple become witnesses of key moments in American history and observe changes taking place in society.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
programme.desc: A mission is underway to destroy the Ring.The team was dispersed.However, each of its members fights in the name of good.The inhabitants of Middle-earth are preparing for a battle that will decide the fate of the world.Gandalf summons the armies of Gondor and Rohan to fight.People need a ruler to unite them more than ever.The descendant of the royal house, Aragorn, must find the power within himself that will allow him to take the throne and fulfill his destiny.Meanwhile, Frodo and Sam, carrying the priceless jewel, approach Mordor.Gollum, who leads them, still hopes to regain the Ring.Using his role as a guide, he leads the hobbits to the spider's cave.At the same time, Sauron's army is approaching the fortress of Minas Tirith in Gondor.People have no chance against the enemy's numerical superiority.Aragorn decides to call for help from an army of wights.Together with the elf Legolas and the dwarf Gimli, he sets off on the Path of the Dead, from which no man has ever returned.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: Challengers
programme.desc: Tennis player Tashi Duncan (Zendaya) has had impressive success on the court in the past.Her career was ended by an injury.Today, the woman is the trainer of Art Donaldson (Mike Faist) - her partner and father of her daughter.The man is one title short of the Grand Slam, but he is struggling with injury and age, which may ruin the pair's ambitions.After a series of defeats, the player plans to take part in the Challenger tournament in New Rochelle, New York, which is to be his warm-up before the US Open and a chance to regain his form.Unexpectedly, in the finale, Art will have to face Patrick Zweig (Josh O'Connor) - his childhood friend and Tashi's ex-boyfriend.The match becomes an opportunity for all three to confront their turbulent past.The film by Italian director Luca Guadagnino, the creator of the Oscar-nominated "Those Days, Those Nights", is a combination of a sports drama and a story about a love triangle.

programme.title: Birdman: Or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) once gained fame as the main actor in a series of films about the adventures of a superhero called Birdman.Currently, the aging Riggan is working on a play that he intends to put on Broadway.He is both its director and the main actor.During rehearsal, one of the actors has an accident.The injured party's successor, Mike (Edward Norton), does not want to submit to the director's vision.Riggan's lover, Laura (Andrea Riseborough), tells him that she is pregnant with his child.His daughter Sam (Emma Stone), a recovered drug addict, also requires support.Soon the actor's dark alter ego begins to reveal itself.The film received four Oscars, including:as the best film.
